description: A controlled evaluation varying three attacker and three defender models under a common scaffold, yielding 945 battles.
label: 3×3 attacker-defender matrix

description: A secure architecture that separates planning into abstract plan generation using trusted information, concrete plan instantiation using installed apps, and isolated execution with static information flow verification.
label: Abstract-Concrete-Execute (ACE)

description: Each battle allows up to 15 rounds, with the attacker retaining history and feedback while the defender starts fresh each round.
label: Adaptive cross-session battles

canonical_name: Agent-empowerment framework for cyber offense–defense lifecycle
description: The first agent-empowerment framework aligned with the full cyber offense–defense lifecycle, covering pre-exploitation, initial access & execution, post-exploitation, identification, protection & detection.
label: Agent-empowerment framework for cyber offense–defense lifecycle

description: A conceptual framework embedding security principles (defense-in-depth, least privilege, complete mediation, psychological acceptability) to provide safeguards throughout an agent’s life-cycle. It includes components: Persistent Agent, Data Minimizer, Ephemeral Agent, I/O Firewall, and Response Filter.
label: AgentSandbox

description: An AI agent that continuously scans the fleet for credential exposure, permission drift, and configuration divergence, and remediates findings. It discovered four HIGH severity issues during the 90-day deployment.
label: Automated Fleet Security Audit System

description: A sidecar container that proxies credential access, preventing agent containers from directly accessing raw secrets stored in configuration files or environment variables.
label: Credential Proxy Sidecar

description: An integrated security framework that operates across multiple protocol layers, including components like Trust Framework, Key Management, and Intrusion Detection System.
label: Cross-layer security framework

description: Simulated a data-poisoning attack by replacing a fraction of training tokens in The Pile with AI-generated medical misinformation using the OpenAI GPT-3.5-turbo API.
label: Data poisoning attack simulation

description: A domain-specific specialization of the ESAA governance kernel for security auditing, using append-only event logs, deterministic orchestration, replay verification, and contract-restricted outputs.
label: ESAA-Security architecture

description: Architectural principles where the append-only event log is the source of truth and current state is reconstructed as a projection of events, with separation of write-oriented effect application from read-oriented materialized views.
label: Event sourcing and CQRS

description: A scheme-level evaluation framework that scores financial LLM agents on robustness (crash foresight, reaction, loss containment, recovery) and security (attacks on information sources, attacks on agents, agent-as-attacker behaviors) using a reproducible codebook.
label: FARSIGHT

description: A pipeline consisting of Syntax Parser, IR Builder, Security Optimizer, and Target Emitter that reduces adaptation complexity from O(m×n) to O(m+n).
label: Four-phase compilation pipeline

description: A four-phase pipeline (reconnaissance, domain audit execution, risk classification, final reporting) with 26 tasks, 16 security domains, and 95 executable checks, producing structured outputs from check-level findings to a final risk-oriented report.
label: Governed audit pipeline

description: Independent Proximal Policy Optimisation, used as a baseline for comparison against MAPPO.
label: IPPO

description: An execution isolation architecture for LLM-based systems that isolates app execution and mediates interactions through well-defined interfaces with user permission. It uses a hub-and-spoke design: a central hub manages user queries and routes them to appropriate apps, each app runs in a separate spoke with its own LLM instance, and an inter-spoke communication protocol enables safe collaboration between apps.
label: ISOLATEGPT

description: A logical component added to sensor nodes to assess security level needs and manage cross-layer interactions, ensuring energy-efficient and non-redundant security operations.
label: Intelligent Security Agent (ISA)

description: Uses gVisor sandboxed containers on Kubernetes to isolate agent workloads at the kernel level, preventing container escapes and limiting the impact of compromised agents.
label: Kernel Level Workload Isolation (gVisor)

description: Proposed a harm mitigation strategy that cross-checks LLM outputs against biomedical knowledge graphs to identify medically harmful content.
label: Knowledge graph-based screening

description: A general-purpose GenAI LLM-based agent powered by three different Ollama-hosted open-source models, designed to perform SAST scanning.
label: LLM-based SAST agent

description: Multi-Agent Proximal Policy Optimisation with a shared critic implementation, used for training defensive agents.
label: MAPPO

description: Ethical prompt engineering, agent systems, and combination, tested to reduce attack success.
label: Mitigation strategies

description: A process to screen scenarios for difficulty and capability sensitivity, involving concept generation, plugin implementation, and calibration.
label: Multi-stage scenario calibration

description: Kubernetes NetworkPolicy rules restrict each agent's outbound network traffic to allowlisted destinations, preventing data exfiltration to unauthorized external services.
label: Network Egress Policy Enforcement

description: The attacker LLM generates each input live, allowing adaptation to the defender.
label: Per-battle attack generation

description: A framework that uses cryptographically structured metadata envelopes and explicit untrusted content labeling to distinguish trusted instructions from untrusted data, mitigating indirect prompt injection attacks.
label: Prompt Integrity Framework

description: Three strategies: text prompt injection, visual prompt injection, and delayed visual prompt injection, with variations in contrast and font size.
label: Prompt injection attacks

description: A unified intermediate representation that decouples skill semantics from framework-specific formatting, enabling portable deployment across agent frameworks.
label: SKIR (Strongly-Typed Intermediate Representation)

description: A static optimizer that enforces security constraints via Anti-Skill Injection, blocking vulnerabilities before deployment.
label: Security Optimizer

description: Conducted 21 semi-structured interviews with U.S. adults who use general-purpose LLM-enabled chatbots for mental health support to explore their security and privacy perceptions.
label: Semi-structured interviews

description: A tool-using, data-grounded security AI agent that translates natural-language ISPM queries into executable data exploration steps over production IAM, IdP, and SaaS tables, returning verifiable, evidence-backed answers.
label: Sola AI Agent

description: Scenario-specific executable checks applied to defender output to determine attack success.
label: Structured checks

description: A structured literature review methodology guided by formal research questions to synthesize existing research, identify critical gaps, and delineate future research trajectories.
label: Structured literature review methodology

canonical_name: Targeted misinformation attack via MLP weight modification
description: Modifying the weights of a single multilayer perceptron (MLP) layer in the transformer using gradient-based updates to inject incorrect biomedical facts while preserving other behaviors.
label: Targeted misinformation attack via MLP weight modification

canonical_name: Taxonomy of LLM agent security threats
description: A taxonomy organized by threat sources, including endogenous, exogenous, and interaction threats, with a mechanistic layer of six foundational architectural failure modes (P1–P6).
label: Taxonomy of LLM agent security threats

description: An attack where attackers manipulate benign users into relaying adversarial content within user requests, relocating external adversarial content into user-provided task context.
label: User-Relayed Context Manipulation (UReCoM)

description: A baseline non-isolated LLM-based system developed for comparison with ISOLATEGPT.
label: VANILLAGPT
